description: Rear extension for seating area (PART RETROSPECTIVE)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Site Location Plan AGL305808PROPOSED BLOCK PLAN P214  22/05/2025EXISTING PLANS P210  22/05/2025EXISTING SECTION & ELEVATIONS P211  22/05/2025PROPOSED SECTION & ELEVATIONS P213  22/05/2025PROPOSED PLANS P212  22/05/2025Design and Access StatementNoise Impact Assessment Rev1.0 dated 25.06.26Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the details already approved, the recommendations for additional noise mitigation measures specified within the Noise Impact Assessment Rev1.0 dated 25.06.26 shall be implemented in full prior to the commencement of use hereby permitted.Reason: To protect the amenity of adjoining occupiers and the surrounding area Policy D14 of the London Plan (2021), Policy DMD 68 of the Development Management Document (2014).

The design and structure of the development hereby approved shall be of such a standard that it will protect residents within the same building or in adjoining buildings from noise and vibration from the development, so that they are not exposed to noise levels indoors of more than 35 dB LAeq 16 hrs daytime and of more than 30 dB LAeq 8 hrs in bedrooms at night. Inside bedrooms 45 dB L Amax is not to be exceeded more than 15 times per nighttime from sources other than emergency sirens.Reason: To protect the amenity of adjoining occupiers and the surrounding area Policy D14 of the London Plan (2021), Policy DMD 68 of the Development Management Document (2014).

Unless within 6 months of the date of this decision, a scheme for the source control SuDS is submitted in writing to the local planning authority for approval, and unless the approved scheme is implemented within 12 months of the local planning authority's approval, the use of the rear extension shall cease until such time as a scheme is approved and implemented. Upon implementation of the approved scheme for the source control SuDS specified in this condition, that scheme shall thereafter be maintained for the duration of the development hereby permitted. In the event of a legal challenge to this decision, or to a decision made pursuant to the procedure set out in this condition, the operation of the time limits specified in this condition will be suspended until that legal challenge has been finally determined.Source control SuDS measures include green roofs, rain gardens and permeable paving. The details must include plans, specifications and maintenance information. The developer should use the SuDS Proforma for minor developers found on the Councils webpage at: https://www.enfield.gov.uk/services/planning/sustainable-drainage-systems to assist them through our requirements.Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD 61, and Policies of the London Plan and the NPPF.
